create.title: Send activation link
create.description: By sharing this link, the user will be able to activate their account and sign in for the first time. This link is personal and shouldn't be shared with anyone else.

reset.title: Send password reset link
reset.description: By sharing this link, the user will be able to create a new password and sign in again. This link is personal and shouldn't be shared with anyone else.

passwordSetupLink.expiryNotice: This link expires in 24 hours. If it's not used, you'll need to generate a new one.
